analysis: Exploratory post-hoc sensitivity audit, not a new untouched test
models: Original four fixed fitted baseline predictors; no training/retuning or forecast replacement
supported: Latest observation at/before decision; both archive timestamp and source report within threshold; original source freshness <=300s; valid counts; renting/returning enabled. Criterion is point evidence, not continuous operating truth.
unsupported: Fails this evidence criterion; does not mean closed or zero latent demand
comparisons: Every model uses identical rows within each stratum. Thresholds change composition; cross-stratum/cross-threshold errors do not identify model gains or missing-at-random selection.
bootstrap: Paired local-day MAE differences, XGBoost minus named baseline, 1000 resamples seed2025; conditional on sampled days and assumptions
operating_truth: The remaining 19632 historical station-hours were not filled. Current prospective data never backfills 2025.
